Planning Code § 732 states that formula retail is not permitted for Limited Restaurant use in the Irving Street Neighborhood Commercial District. Two formula retail limited restaurant Conditional Use Authorization applications on this block (The Mochi Donut Shop at 2126 Irving and Krispy Krunchy Chicken at 2130 Irving) were cancelled in 2021–2022 without reaching a Planning Commission hearing; the records do not state why they were cancelled. Planning staff stated in a 2021 health referral for The Mochi Donut Shop that formula retail use is not permitted in the Irving NCD and that while standardized merchandise is allowed, additional standardized features (branding, decor, facade treatments) would not be permitted without Conditional Use Authorization approval, which was never obtained. Obtain a written zoning determination from San Francisco Planning before filing any application or signing a lease.
